name: Nezuko Kamado
summary: During the Swordsmith Village Arc, Nezuko continued to grow stronger without consuming humans. She fought alongside Tanjiro against Hantengu's emotion clones and demonstrated enough physical power to contend with demons capable of destroying large structures. Her rapid growth continued to increase her overall combat capabilities.

stats.durability: Varies, At most Small Town level, likely higher
stats.range: Standard Melee Range, Several Meters with Blood Burst

notes: This version covers Nezuko's Swordsmith Village Arc development prior to her adaptation to sunlight. She could battle Hantengu's emotion clones, which were capable of shattering a giant mansion with ease. Her power continued to increase through her Reactive Power Level.
